div.head: Mirce 3.1
div.ab: And for þam cynedome gebyrað oþer swilc to bote on cynegylde.
7 for ðam cynedóme gebireð oðer swilc to bote on cynegilde.
Set pro regni emendatione (dignitate) debet addi tantumdem in cynegildo.
and on account of the kingship there belongs a second sum as compensation in payment for a king.
And for the kingship there is a second compensation owed equal to that of the king.
Jedoch für die Königswürde [die staatliche Königsbusse wird diesem hinzugenommen noch einmal so viel bei K. lq] gebührt als Busse bei Königs-Entgeltung eine zweite solche [Summe].
But for the kingship a second such [sum] is due as compensation in the king's payment [the public king-compensation is added to it, as much again, lq].
div.note: K: ‘ðam’ corrected to H's ‘þam’. Liebermann compares Norðleod 1.
